results.title: Two concurrent ingests into the discovery register
results.evidence: 1 reference(s) are held by more than one row after two concurrent sweeps: ['DISC-0004']. `ingest` mints `DISC-{n:04d}` from a count of the rows already there, so two sweeps that read the same count produce the same reference — and a triage queue where two candidates answer to one name is one where dismissing a spreadsheet dismisses somebody else's
